subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this external Discord message-delivery PR be held for retained after-fix Discord proof, or may maintainers accept the source-level tests plus unretained canary observation?
rationale: The code shape looks focused, but ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate cannot treat unretained operator observation as sufficient proof for a user-visible Discord delivery change.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed progress is hidden and fallback warnings still deliver before merge.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the source-level tests and canary observation despite the missing retained live artifact.

options.title: Pause until branch is refreshed
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the contributor refreshes the conflicting branch and can provide proof from the refreshed head.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed progress is hidden and fallback warnings still deliver before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history across Discord and shared channel-progress behavior touched by this PR.
